class.name: TerrainMaterialLayer
class.brief_description: One surface of a [TerrainMaterial3D]: rock, scree, soil, alluvium or sand.
class.description: Textures, tint, tiling and porosity of one ground surface. Every texture is optional; without textures the layer is its [member color] and [member roughness]. Textures are sampled in world space, so they never stretch over the terrain's mesh.

members.member: Height texture (red channel) used for height blending: where two layers meet, the higher one wins, so stones poke through sand instead of fading into it.
How much the layer darkens and smooths when wet (see [member BaseMaterial3D.wetness_porosity]).
Roughness, multiplied by [member roughness_texture]'s green channel.
Size in metres one repeat of the textures covers.
